questions: Q1: What CLI commands exist for library operations and what's missing?
Q2: What patterns should new commands follow?

answers.answer: Current commands: list, show <ref>, comments list|post <ref>. Missing: create (new report from file), iterate <ref> --file (new version), publish <ref>, delete <ref>. The publish and delete API endpoints already exist server-side (POST /library/items/:itemId/publish, DELETE /library/items/:itemId) but the CLI does not expose them. Create and iterate require new server endpoints.
evidence: src/library/index.ts: switch cases for list, show, comments only
Server api.ts lines 413-414: POST publish and DELETE endpoints exist
Ticket description: 'CLI (hlx library create --file, iterate <ref> --file, publish, delete)'

answers.answer: Consistent dispatcher pattern: subcommand router (index.ts) dispatches to command functions that call hxFetch with API key auth. Flag parsing via getFlag/requireFlag utilities. Reference resolution via resolve-library-item.ts (3-tier: exact ID, ticket short ID, title substring). New commands should follow this same structure. For file-based commands (create/iterate), the CLI would read local files and POST content to the API.
evidence: src/lib/http.ts: hxFetch with retry, API key auth, org header

statement: The CLI needs four new commands: create, iterate, publish, delete. Publish and delete can be implemented immediately against existing server endpoints. Create and iterate depend on new server API endpoints. All commands follow the established dispatcher + hxFetch + flag-parsing pattern. Reference resolution via resolve-library-item.ts is reusable for iterate/publish/delete.
